title: A Baby Blue Whale Gains 200 Pounds Every Single Day

scenes.text: A baby blue whale gains 200 pounds every day.
That's about 90 kilograms a day, for its first year.
In ten days, it adds almost a ton. In a month, nearly three.
And all it drinks is its mother's milk.
That's how the biggest animal that has ever lived gets so big.
Two hundred pounds, every day, on milk alone.

description:
A baby blue whale gains 200 pounds every day.
Blue whale calves put on about 90 kilograms a day, and they live on nothing but their mother's milk. That growth helps make the blue whale the biggest animal that has ever lived.
How much did you weigh as a baby? Comment below.
first_comment: Blue whale calves are already among the biggest babies on Earth at birth. Guess how much a human baby gains in a day?
